description: Return the final tenant-scoped transaction row from TicketService.update after an actual status change, preserving description rendering and the existing update response shape.
Both ticket PUT endpoints return is_closed=true and persisted closed_at/closed_by on an open-to-closed transition.
Both ticket PUT endpoints return is_closed=false and null closed_at/closed_by when reopening.
Preserve closure timestamp and actor when moving between closed statuses or repeating the current closed status.
Preserve correct closure metadata for open-to-open, same-open-status, and non-status updates.
Keep the refresh tenant-scoped and transactional while preserving existing invalid-status and close-rule rejection behavior.
